# Getting started with Workbooks

<!-- GENERATED by `work weave` from skills/getting_started.work — do not edit; edit the source docs it composes. -->

A **workbook is a folder of `.work` files** — literate documents where prose narrates
and `do … end` blocks run. There is no HTML, no code fences, no markdown: you write
`.work`, and the `work` CLI weaves and ships it. Start here to learn the model, the
file format, and the CLI verbs before authoring anything.

When the user wants to make or ship a workbook, read the references below in order —
they take you from "what is a workbook" to running the `work` CLI.
